_note: Single source for the Claude account picker (docs/claude-accounts.md). dir null = the default ~/.claude with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR unset; never set it to ~/.claude (changes the Keychain service). loginBrowser = the macOS app (name for `open -a`) signed in to that account, where claude-relogin opens the authorize URL. fable = Fable mode: the account `cf` launches on, held back as the last resort from every other pick (null = off, cf on the default account). drain = accounts filled first in every lane up to 100 % weekly while their 5h window is cool (empty or absent = off; never the fable account); take an account out once it is full.
